operating_entities.note: Page intro: 'The Sun Life Financial group of companies provide insurance and wealth management services to our customers around the world.' It is a flat list (Canada region) with no parent/child structure, so parent is null for every row; sunlife.com 'Who we are' separately identifies Sun Life Financial Inc. as the TSX/NYSE/PSE-listed holding company. No page on sunlife.com/sunlife.ca names who manages the general account; the fuller legal-entity disclosure is the annual-report appendix 'Subsidiaries and associates' PDF (sunlife.com/content/dam/.../subsidiaries-associates-2025-e.pdf), which is a filing extract, not a website entities page. sunlife.ca/en/legal/ returned HTTP 403; sunlife.com/sl/pslf-worldwide/en/legal/ is terms-of-use only.

cio.name: Randy (Randolph) Brown
cio.title: Chief Investment Officer, Sun Life; Head of Insurance Asset Management, SLC Management; leads the Office of the CIO
cio.entity: Sun Life Financial Inc. / Sun Life Assurance Company of Canada (Office of the CIO, within the Sun Life Asset Management pillar, housed in SLC Management)
cio.reports_to: Tom Murphy, President, Sun Life Asset Management (Office of the CIO is listed as part of the Sun Life Asset Management pillar from 2026-01-01; the reporting line itself is not stated). At appointment (Jan 2016) he reported to Steve Peacher.
cio.prior: Deutsche Asset & Wealth Management 2007-15 (Co-CIO Deutsche Asset Management; Global Head of Insurance & Pension Solutions; Head of AWM UK), BlackRock (co-head portfolio management, Financial Institutions Group), Morgan Stanley, Salomon Brothers
cio.tenure_source: press release Jan 2016 (Sun Life newsroom / Investment Executive / Insurance Asset Risk) + SLC Management bio via search snippet ('joined Sun Life at the start of 2016'); LinkedIn profile exists (linkedin.com/in/randy-brown-1662a17) but snippet carried no dates
cio.note: Not an NEO; pay undisclosed. Listed as 'Chief Investment Officer' on the Q1-2026 results presentation leadership slide. SLC bio: manages Sun Life's General Account globally (public and private fixed income, real estate equity/debt, infrastructure equity), leads the Office of the CIO, member of SLC Management Executive Committee and Sun Life Leadership Team; leads SLC's insurance business (US$119bn AUM). Steve Peacher (Executive Chair, SLC Management; NEO, 2025 total C$9,693,259) is described in the circular as responsible for the invested asset portfolio and SLC Management - the more senior investment executive by pay/governance, but Brown holds the CIO title and GA accountability. Industry start (~30 years) not dated in any source.

gaps: CIO direct reports: no team page or release names the Office of the CIO leadership. SLC Management job postings show the structure (Managing Director & Chief of Staff, Office of the CIO; Associate Director Insurance Strategy, Office of the CIO; Associate Director Performance & Risk, Office of CIO; Director Portfolio Strategy & Analytics bridging SLC front office and Sun Life ALM/Capital/Risk/Finance) but not the holders. The 'Asia General Account team' inside the Office of the CIO is unnamed. slcmanagement.com (our-people pages) returns HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch.

Peter Cramer (Senior Managing Director, Head of Insurance Portfolio Management & Trading, SLC Fixed Income) and Rich Familetti (President & CIO, Fixed Income, SLC Management, Sep 2025) run GA fixed income day-to-day but sit in SLC Fixed Income; no source says they report to Randy Brown, so they are not listed.

Global ALM: Brennan Kennedy was SVP, Global Asset Liability Management until he became Chief Actuary on 2025-10-04; his successor is not announced. ALM reported through the CRO (Murphy had oversight of Actuarial and ALM from Dec 2022), not the CIO.

Randy Brown: industry start year and any LinkedIn experience lines not retrievable; placement in the SLAM pillar is stated (Office of the CIO listed in the pillar) but 'reports to Tom Murphy' is inferred from that.

Entities page lists only the nine Canadian privacy-covered companies; SLC Management, MFS, BGO/GreenOak, Crescent, InfraRed, Sun Life (U.S.) etc. appear only in the annual-report subsidiaries PDF, which is not a website entities page under rule 1.
Web-search budget exhausted before searches for the Asia General Account head and Office-of-the-CIO MDs could be completed.
notes: Oct 6 2025 announcement (sunlife.com 'Accelerating on our ambition'): Sun Life Asset Management brings together MFS, GreenOak (SLC Management rebrand), Defined Benefit Solutions (PRT), 'The Office of the CIO, including the Asia General Account team', Asia Asset Management and the Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC stake, under Tom Murphy as President from 2026-01-01. Pay figures carried from the first-round file (2026 circular, FY2025).
